status: locked before first file download and any model computation
question: One EuroSAT/SigLIP frozen-patch pilot: whether complete conditional first and second moments account for the prespecified clipping phenomenon.
clock: Persistent monotonic and UTC deadline begins before the first direct metadata/package/asset HTTP request. Retries never reset clocks/counters. Supervisor kills worker at earliest active deadline. Preliminary browser-only source inspection and code preparation precede the clock.
device: Mac MPS only for model work except the mandatory 20-image CPU parity check; no Colab and no MPS fallback. CPU image decoding/preprocessing and CPU augmentation are intentional.

dependencies.isolation: deps/ via --target --no-deps --no-index from verified official PyPI wheels; existing project Python/Torch retained
dependencies.resolution: Resolve necessary non-extra dependencies from official PyPI, using existing versions when satisfying constraints, otherwise latest non-prerelease compatible wheel; record URLs/versions/SHA256 before install. No source distributions.

manifest.rgb_sha256: SHA256 of decoded 64x64x3 uint8 RGB bytes; any cross-label duplicate stops
manifest.sort: SHA256(UTF8 salt + NUL + bytes.fromhex(rgb_sha256)), tie by rgb_sha256
manifest.confirmation: 10 from remaining 90/class sampled without replacement separately for each episode using NumPy default_rng(episode_seed), classes sorted lexicographically

encoder.preprocessing: official pinned SiglipImageProcessor: RGB, bicubic resize to 224x224, rescale 1/255, mean/std .5; no augmentation
encoder.cache: post_layernorm last_hidden_state before MAP; 196x768; no CLS; float32 memmap; no extra normalization

parity.development_images: first two calibration images of each class (20 total)

head.init: fresh CPU construction; apply pinned official SiglipPreTrainedModel._init_weights to MAP; classifier normal std=768^-0.5 and zero bias. Seed=episode seed; record complete tensor-state hash before every fit.

augmentation.C: shared uniform offset per sample/channel, channel minmax over token, assigned clipping
augmentation.E: independent uniform per token/channel; otherwise same as C
augmentation.GC: exact complete conditional channel covariance via sorted GL nodes and prefix sums
augmentation.GE: exact coordinate mean/variance with independent normals
augmentation.math_dtype: float64 from fixed float32 cache; augmented feature output cast float32 for MPS

preflight.moment_images: first calibration image of first two classes
preflight.dense_oracle_scope: only these 2 images x 4 channels, both a; no full-dataset dense factors
preflight.time_projection: sum of remaining 400-update fit counts times worst of two a's post-warmup p90 update time per arm + 6 worst-a support prep times + 96000/20 times preflight p90 eval batch time + 180 seconds archival reserve; must be <=75% remaining wall clock

fit.batch_order: 80 epochs, independently shuffle each class's 10 support examples then five class-balanced batches; shuffle within each batch; default_rng(10000+episode_seed); identical across arms
fit.decay_rule: p.ndim>=2 including learned probe; no bias or LayerNorm decay
fit.schedule: updates 1..20 LR=base*step/20; updates21..400 LR=base*(1+cos(pi*(step-20)/380))/2, final LR zero
fit.loss: mean CE, no label smoothing, no grad clipping
fit.augmentation_rng: NumPy SeedSequence([20261030, phase_id, episode_seed, arm_index, a_index]); independent of sampler RNG

calibration.selection: highest final validation accuracy; ties smaller LR, larger WD; then C highest validation accuracy, tie smaller a; all arms inherit LR/WD and augmented arms inherit a

confirmation.validation: omit optional confirmation validation to honor evaluation cap
confirmation.test: all 30 final head states sealed before a single final evaluation pass; clean cached features only; no interim test metrics

statistics.unit: six complete paired episodes, conditional on fixed pool and test
statistics.phenomenon: mean g,h each >=1pp and each one-sided95% lower >0
statistics.equivalence: all three I,dC,dE two-sided90% CIs within [-.5,+.5]pp
statistics.local_insufficiency: at least one I,dC,dE Bonferroni family95% CI (individual98.333333%) wholly >+.5 or <-.5pp
statistics.incomplete_pairs: descriptive archive only, no equivalence claim

stop_rules: Any budget/preflight failure stops; never shrink recipe, add seeds, swap data/model, pick arm-specific hyperparameters, or attribute Gaussian failures to one mechanism. No Q arm. No automatic next experiment.
scope_limits: No spatial OOD claim; pretraining overlap not excluded; no benchmark expansion; no commit/push/upload/external asset publication. Preserve previous fixture and other project directories.
